name: Naturalisation/Registration as a British Overseas Territories Citizen (BOTC)

requirements.blocker_text: Application is made through the Office of the Deputy Governor's online portal for 'British Overseas Territories Citizenship Registration and Naturalisation.' The portal's public-facing login page does not itself state the substantive eligibility criteria (residence duration, character, fees) in the content reviewed.

evidence_required.document: Online portal registration and application (specific document list not itemised in the source reviewed)

sources.title: Office of the Deputy Governor, Cayman Islands -- BOTC Registration and Naturalisation online portal (login page confirms the process and administering authority; substantive criteria are behind account registration)

notes: STATUS: DRAFT, part of the Cayman Islands' initial build. This is the genuine BOTC 'citizenship' track for the Cayman Islands, distinct from the local 'right to be Caymanian' routes (see ky_caymanian_status_descent.json's notes for that distinction). Same gap pattern as Montserrat's ms_naturalisation.json: the official portal confirms the process and administering authority (Office of the Deputy Governor) but the actual eligibility criteria sit behind a login wall not accessible in this pass. citizenship_after_months is left null rather than assumed immediate, since it is not confirmed whether holding Cayman's own permanent residence or Caymanian status is a precondition, unlike Anguilla's equivalent route where a Permanent Resident Permit was explicitly required.
